name: Machu Picchu

photo.alt: Stone buildings and mountain setting at Machu Picchu, July 2015
photo.author: Diego Delso

note: Inca stone buildings and terraces occupy a steep ridge above the Urubamba gorge, surrounded by tropical mountain forest.

name: Machu Picchu Pueblo · Aguas Calientes

photo.alt: Aguas Calientes stream and the town around it, April 2025
photo.author: Jorge Castro Ruso

note: The river town below the sanctuary, with rail arrivals, a central plaza, and thermal baths along the Aguas Calientes stream.

name: Urubamba

photo.alt: Bridge, river, and Urubamba town, November 2019
photo.author: Thayne Tuason

note: A major town on the broad floor of the Sacred Valley, beside the Vilcanota–Urubamba river corridor.

name: Ollantaytambo

photo.alt: Ollantaytambo archaeological site, photographed in March 1984
photo.author: Bernard Gagnon

note: Town and Inca archaeological complex where terraces climb above the valley.

name: Cusco

photo.alt: Cathedral and Plaza de Armas in Cusco, July 2015
photo.author: Diego Delso

note: The former Inca capital occupies a high Andean basin; its historic center combines Inca urban foundations with colonial buildings.

name: Sacsayhuamán

photo.alt: Monumental stone walls at Sacsayhuamán, July 2015
photo.author: Diego Delso

note: Monumental fitted-stone walls rise on the hillside above Cusco. The photograph shows masonry details that regional terrain cannot resolve.

name: Pisac

photo.alt: Q’alla Q’asa sector of the Pisac archaeological site above the town, March 2024
photo.author: MorePix

note: The town lies beneath a large Inca archaeological landscape of terraces and stone buildings on the mountain above.

name: Moray
note: Concentric Inca terraces descend into natural depressions on the plateau above the Sacred Valley.

name: Salineras de Maras

photo.alt: Salt evaporation ponds at Maras, July 2015
photo.author: Diego Delso

note: Salt ponds step down the ravine below Maras. This 3D scene has level basins, raised rims, and salt-crusted retaining walls within the mapped compound. Individual pond shapes and heights are illustrative, not a survey.

name: Maras
note: A plateau town above the Sacred Valley, near the salt ponds and the terraces of Moray.

name: Chinchero
note: A highland town and archaeological park in Urubamba province, with stone terraces and a historic church above the valley.

name: Chinchero International Airport · construction

photo.alt: Historical view of Chinchero airport construction behind the town, May 2023
photo.author: Draceane

note: Airport construction on the Chinchero plateau. The mapped construction boundary appears as graded ground; individual runway and terminal layouts are not mapped here. Official June 2026 reports describe continuing works. Photo: May 2023.

name: Calca

photo.alt: Calca town viewed toward the west, November 2019
photo.author: Thayne Tuason

note: A valley town on a short plain between mountains, where the Ccocho stream descends toward the Vilcanota.

name: Yucay
note: A Sacred Valley town with historic plazas and the church of Santiago Apóstol.

name: Lamay

photo.alt: Lamay seen from the church, November 2019
photo.author: Thayne Tuason

note: A Sacred Valley town between Pisac and Calca, beside the river corridor.

name: Coya
note: A town along the Sacred Valley river corridor between Pisac and Lamay.

name: Huayllabamba
note: A Sacred Valley town east of Yucay and Urubamba.

name: Alejandro Velasco Astete Airport
note: Cusco’s operational airport, within the city east of the historic centre. The mapped 10/28 runway is 3,400 metres long and 45 metres wide. The terminal footprint has a mapped height of 8 metres and two levels. Taxiway widths and runway paint are illustrative.
